name: Reconcile Premium
description: MMQR / KBZPay / WavePay reconciliation against the POS sales ledger, with LIVE intra-day shortfall flagging by staff member and shift. This is the Pro differentiator: free-tier tenants keep the plain end-of-day close; Pro tenants get shortfalls surfaced while the shift is still on the floor.
free_tier_fallback: end-of-day close summary only — no intra-day shortfall flags, no per-staff/shift breakdown

intake.description: Raw settlement exports (CSV/JSON), payment webhook payloads, and the POS sales ledger for the same window. Any subset works — the matcher reports exactly what it could not cover.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Normalize whatever arrives (CSV/JSON exports, webhook payloads, pasted text) into one canonical transactions table: source, txn_id, amount_mmk, timestamp, staff, shift, channel. Flag rows that could not be parsed instead of dropping them.

roles.title: Settlement Matcher
roles.goal: Match every POS sale to its KBZPay/WavePay/MMQR settlement row by amount, timestamp window, and reference. Classify every unmatched row: missing_settlement, missing_sale, amount_mismatch, or duplicate.

roles.title: Shortfall Sentinel
roles.goal: PRO ONLY (live, intra-day): group open mismatches by staff member and shift as transactions arrive; raise a shortfall flag the moment a pattern clears the noise floor (repeated missing settlements on one staff/shift, not one-off timing lag), with the evidence rows attached to the flag.

roles.title: Close Writer
roles.goal: Write the end-of-day close: totals per channel, matched percentage, open exceptions with their classification, and (Pro) every intra-day flag raised with its resolution status.

output_contract.description: One reconciliation packet per close: machine rows for the ledger plus a short operator narrative. shortfall_flags and flags_by_staff_shift are empty arrays on the free tier (end-of-day close only).
